text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened one day as the year was 
drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> received an invitation to the Grow-Up 
Race, the first of the "Special Races" 
hosted by the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being chosen as a member of the Triple 
Goddesses—who are both reassuring 
supporters and figures to aspire to—brings 
both joy and renewed determination.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
This past year, the successes achieved by 
you and <chrname>-chan have been truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we chose to have them stand 
upon this stage.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
However, the other Umamusume have also 
undergone tremendous growth, standing on 
the threshold of the pinnacle—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
As a one-of-a-kind partner, do you have 
the confidence that you have devoted 
yourself to your Umamusume, walked 
alongside her, and achieved growth second 
to none?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's a fine answer, full of 
resolve!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Even though it hasn't been very long, you 
seem to have built a wonderful 
relationship with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is time for the race. I wish <chrname> the 
best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"Show them your unique charm that shines 
brighter than anyone under the sun!"
